title: Profound's Advertising Strategy: Meta, LinkedIn and Google Ads
summary: Profound runs 232 Meta ads, 361 LinkedIn ads and 207 Google ads. 91 Meta ads sell a free AEO audit call. A one-week test of 119 ads picked the winners, and the 113 after it run a median 32 days.
body_markdown:
Profound runs sales-led ads in a category where a lot of the tools let you sign up and start. Its biggest Meta message is "Book a Free AEO Audit Call for Your Company". 91 ads. It sells a meeting, not a trial.


Ramp's October 2026 AI category data has Profound as the most-purchased AEO vendor, at 53% of buyers in the category. So the ads are worth reading. They are not the ads of a company chasing signups.


Meta is the newer channel. Profound's whole Meta history starts on 11 August 2026: 232 ads since, 173 of them in August alone, and 119 of them launched in a single test week, all off by 18 August. LinkedIn is bigger, at 361 ads. Google has 207.


One of the 91 "Book a Free AEO Audit Call" ads. The call to action in the image is "Get a demo". As of 13 October 2026.


## Profound ads: key findings


- **63** LinkedIn ads posted by **10** creators who don't work at Profound, each link tagged utm_content=influencer with the creator's name
- **176** of 361 LinkedIn ads are posted by a person, not the page. **107** by the two co-founders
- **112 of 232** Meta ads go to a Meta lead form or straight to /contact-sales, never the rest of the site
- **29** Meta ads use Meta's own lead forms. 13 gate a travel report
- **56** ads across Meta, Google and LinkedIn tell one customer story: MongoDB
- **41** ads sell the Zero Click tour: London 22 October, Sydney 27 October, Singapore 29 October
- **119** Meta ads launched 11-17 August as a test week, all off by 18 August. The 113 launched after run a median **32 days**
- **0** affiliate or referral programs. The partner program certifies agencies


## How Profound's funnel is wired


The tracking tags on Profound's links say more about the program than the headlines do.


### A LinkedIn creator bench, counted one creator at a time


63 LinkedIn ads are promoted posts by 10 people who don't work at Profound. Their links carry utm_content=influencer, plus a utm_term with the creator's own name. For the Series D webinar, the campaign is "seriesd-webinar-marketing-team-future".


Creator Who they are Ads


Sara McNamara B2B RevOps consultant 11


Kyle Poyar Growth Unhinged newsletter 9


Carmen Vicente Social strategist, LinkedIn Top Voice 9

Kyle Poyar also fronts a pricing webinar under a campaign named after him. The Aim launch used the same pattern with a different label, utm_source=li-<name>.


Per-creator tags mean every creator's sign-ups are counted separately, so the next round of posts can go to whoever filled the webinar. Add the co-founders' 107 ads and a few staff, and 176 of the 361 LinkedIn ads are posted by a person, not the page.


### Meta skips the website


29 Meta ads use Meta's own lead forms: the ad opens a form inside Facebook or Instagram, and the link reads fb.me.


Lead-form ad Ads


See How Travelers Are Using AI 13


Book a Free AEO Audit Call for Your Company 9


How Will Shoppers Find You in AI? 4


Reddit Is Reshaping AI Visibility 2


90% of CMOs Use LLMs Daily 1


Another 83 go straight to /contact-sales. That's 112 of 232 Meta ads asking for a meeting or an email without sending anyone to browse the site. The industry reports, travel and retail, capture the email. The audit call is the meeting.


### One story, three channels, one URL


"MongoDB Grew AI Visibility 50%" runs in 38 Meta ads, 12 Google ads and 6 LinkedIn ads. The landing page is the case study itself, /customers/mongodb. On Meta it grew from 3 ads in the test week to 35 after.


### An event tour as a geo funnel


41 ads sell Zero Click by Profound: London on 22 October, Sydney on 27 October, Singapore on 29 October. LinkedIn carries London, aimed at lists of 18 to 25 countries across Europe, with Israel included. Meta carries the Sydney and Singapore dates.


## Who Profound pays to promote it


No affiliate program and no referral program. /affiliates and /referral are both 404s. The partner program is for agencies, vetted on customer status, Profound University certification and client results.


The creator work is newer. A New York listing for a Creator Marketing Manager, $120,000 to $180,000, set out to "build Profound's creator program from scratch", adding that "the best partnerships won't feel like ads". It was taken down on 31 August 2026. The LinkedIn tags above show the program running regardless.


## Meta: a meeting, a case study, then research


### 232 ads, a test week, then the winners


Every one of the 232 Meta ads launched after 11 August 2026. That is the whole account. 173 went live in August and the biggest single day, 16 August, had 39 launches. Then 45 in September and 14 so far in October.


Behind the 232 sit 47 groups of near-identical creative, plus 33 ads that belong to no group. The same few creatives are cloned many times, up to 14 ad objects for one concept.


Launch month Meta ads launched


August 2026 (from the 11th) 173


September 2026 45


October 2026 (to the 13th) 14


Then the test week. 119 ads launched between 11 and 17 August. The median ran 1 day, and all 119 were off by 18 August. A single test week.


Then 7 quiet days with no launches. The 113 ads launched from 25 August have a median life of 32 days.


Message Test week (11-17 Aug) From 25 Aug


MongoDB story 3 35


Audit call 46 45


Travel research 13 0


"Where does your brand rank" hook 48 4


A one-week sprint picked the winners. The MongoDB story and the audit call came back. Travel research and the ranking hook did not.


### What the 232 say


Message (headline) Meta ads Where it goes


Book a Free AEO Audit Call for Your Company 91 /contact-sales (76)


MongoDB Grew AI Visibility 50% 38 MongoDB case study


Find out where your brand ranks in AI search, plus 25 ads with the same copy and no headline 52 AEO report, Profound Index, or a form


See How Travelers Are Using AI 13 Travel research


Zero Click is coming to Sydney (Oct 27) and Singapore (Oct 29) 8 Event pages


Meet Aim, Built for Marketers 7 Aim product page


Meet the AI Marketer: Download the Blueprint 6 Blueprint download


Is AI Getting Your Brand Right? 5 FactCheck launch post


Everything else 12 Mixed


I counted the first row twice. 91 ads, 39% of the account, with one headline. Of those, 76 point at the contact-sales page and 15 at the homepage or a Meta-hosted form. The body copy says it plainly: book a free audit call and "we'll show you exactly where you rank in AI search".


The creative inside is a product-style dark card. A line about where buyers are going, and a "Get a demo" link. Nothing in the ad asks anyone to try the product on their own.


### One customer story, 38 times


The travel research ad. The report behind it is built on 4,352 prompts across ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini.


The second-biggest message is a case study. "MongoDB Grew AI Visibility 50%." 38 ads. The body is a single sentence: MongoDB used Profound Agents to cut schema markup update time by almost 30%, with expert review kept in the loop. The same MongoDB headline runs in 6 Google video ads and shows up in the LinkedIn feed too.


MongoDB had 3 ads in the test week and 35 after it. It is the message the test week promoted.


### Research as the free thing


When Profound does give something away, it is research. 13 ads promote a travel report: "Profound analyzed 4,352 real prompts across ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini". 12 link to the AEO report and 8 to the Profound Index. Another group quotes a shopping study of 200,000 prompts and a 50,000-response study that found 47% of response content was unsolicited.


The AEO report and Profound Index ads share one hook: "AI Search has a leaderboard. Your brand is on it. Most teams have no idea where they rank or who's beating them." 52 ads. Two endings: "See where you stand" and "Book a call to see where you stand".


### Product launches, in small packs


Launches are small. Aim has 7 ads, the Blueprint download 6, FactCheck 5, and the two Zero Click event stops 8 between them. Aim is described as running "in the background to surface ranked AI Search opportunities and turn accepted ideas into projects". The Blueprint pitches "a marketing expert who knows your brand".


The Blueprint cover, used in 6 Meta ads. The same pitch runs in 18 LinkedIn Document ads.


## LinkedIn: 361 ads, and it is the bigger channel


LinkedIn is where the volume is. 361 ads, against 232 on Meta. And the mix is different.


LinkedIn ad type Ads


Single Image Ad 138


Message Ad 136


Video Ad 69


Document Ad 18


### Message ads are the sales machine


136 Message ads, sent from the Profound page. 123 carry copy, and that copy is 17 distinct messages. They open "Hey %FIRSTNAME%" and merge in the company name or job title. 86 of them ask for a call. 58 offer a free Profound Index report for your industry.


One reads: "Ask ChatGPT for the best tools in %COMPANYNAME%'s category. Does your name come up?" and ends with a quick call and a free Index report. Another names Estée Lauder, Walmart and Cursor and says a third of the Fortune 100 use the AI Marketer. A few are invites to the Zero Click events.


The 42 Message ads that show targeting list 18 countries, 17 of them European, plus Israel. On one of them the United Kingdom took 50% of impressions.


### Founders and employees post the ads


185 of the 361 ads come from the Profound page. The other 176 are posted by 14 named people. Two of them, co-founders James Cadwallader (61 ads) and Dylan Babbs (46), account for 107. The other 12 posters, including newsletter founder Kyle Poyar with 9 ads, have 11 or fewer each.


All 176 are image or video posts: 110 image ads and 66 video ads. The Message and Document formats stay with the company page.


A customer-proof ad posted by James Cadwallader: Kiteworks in 30 days.


### What the posters say


- **Events:** 33 ads mention Zero Click by Profound. London on 22 October, Sydney on 27 October, Singapore on 29 October.
- **The raise:** 40 ads mention the $180 million Series D at a $1.8 billion valuation.
- **Customer proof:** 15 ads cover MongoDB, Kiteworks, Optro or Snap.
- **Product ships:** "New ship from Profound" posts for Citation Coverage and the YouTube Citation Breakdown, and the news that the Profound MCP is an official Anthropic connector.


The Blueprint document ad, the pitch behind the 18 LinkedIn Document ads.


### Document ads, and how little reach most have


18 Document ads all push the same Blueprint: "Picture a marketing expert who knows your brand, catches what's worth acting on, and gets the work done before you ask." They use 4 different cover images.


Of the 100 LinkedIn ads that show an impressions band, 68 sit under 1,000 impressions. A handful reach 50,000 or more. Those 100 dated ads started 64 in August, 27 in September and 9 in October.


## Google: 207 ads, and the oldest is from June 2025


Google is the oldest channel on the account. The first Google ad ran in June 2025, more than a year before Meta begins. Of 207 ads, 116 are text, 65 are video and 26 are image. 98 were last shown in October 2026.


Meta and LinkedIn ask for a call. Google text ads use a different hook, one that sounds self-serve: 26 end "Analyze Your Brand Free" and go to the homepage. 18 open on "Try Profound Instead". Video repeats MongoDB (6 ads) and "Control Your AI Brand Story" (6). The ads cover 61 regions.


Channel Ads Main ask


Meta 232 Book an audit call (91 ads)


LinkedIn 361 Book a call, get an Index report (136 Message ads)


Google 207 Analyze your brand free (26 text ads)


## What actually makes this work


The ask matches the buyer. An AEO platform sold to a marketing team is not a purchase made in a Meta feed. So the ads sell the next step: a call, with a free report for your industry as the reason to take it.


Proof sits next to the ask. One customer story at 38 ads. Research with a number in the headline. A funding round, a partner logo or a citation table, from a founder's own LinkedIn profile.


And the shape of the Meta account says the test came first. 119 ads in one week, all gone by 18 August, then 113 ads on the messages that survived, living a median 32 days. The audit call and the MongoDB story are what the account kept.
